sources.production_scope: Current GOV.UK pages establish Akrotiri as BFPO 57 with shadow postcode BF1 2AT and instruct senders to use the BFPO number rather than a town or country. OGL v3 permits reuse of GOV.UK content subject to its terms, but these route/format pages contain no postal area geometry.

Current OGL GOV.UK material identifies Akrotiri within the Sovereign Base Areas, and the Security Services page independently uses RAF Akrotiri, BFPO 57. This identity/address context never supplies a postal perimeter.

sources.provider: Cyprus Department of Lands and Surveys
sources.production_scope: The official September 2025 ZIP contains 870 valid Polygon features and one 1,285-point Akrotiri/4640 Polygon in CGRS93 LTM. It is a Cyprus DLS postal-sector assertion, not proof that 4640 equals BFPO 57, BF1 2AT, all XU territory or all eligible users. No resource-specific compatible processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving licence was established.

sources.provider: Cyprus Department of Lands and Surveys
sources.production_scope: The current API catalog lists postal-code areas under CadastralMap but directs users to contact the portal manager for access. The disclaimer describes site information as advisory and not legal text; it does not grant AGID-compatible processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights. No contact or API access request was made.

artifact_partitions.rule: BFPO 57, BF1 2AT, eligibility and routing retain MOD provenance and explicit route/non-area semantics unless postal authority supplies area geometry.
4640 retains Cyprus postal-operator provenance and cannot be inferred solely from a DLS name/code feature.
The DLS Akrotiri/4640 Polygon remains external validation until compatible rights and operator/XU reconciliation are fixed.
XU, Cyprus, Dhekelia, Episkopi, Ayios Nikolaos and combined SBA context remain distinct.
Addresses, routes, offices and buildings remain separate and are not buffered into geometry.
Non-production fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
